name: http-server
description: A zero-dependency HTTP/1.1 Web Server built from scratch using Node.js TCP sockets. Implements raw request parsing, header and cookie mapping, body buffers, a parameterized routing tree, middleware orchestration, and response formatting helpers.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need a lightweight web server with routing, middlewares, and cookie/body parsing without importing express, fastify, or other external server libraries.
